segments.text: A centrifuge is a machine that uses rapid rotation to apply centrifugal force to its
segments.zh: 离心机是一种利用高速旋转对其内容物施加离心力、

segments.text: contents, separating them by density.
segments.zh: 按密度将其分离的机器。

segments.text: The higher density materials will sink to the bottom of the container, while lower
segments.zh: 密度较高的物质会沉到容器底部，而密度较低的

segments.text: density materials will rise to the top.
segments.zh: 物质会上升到顶部。

segments.text: Centrifuges come in multiple sizes.
segments.zh: 离心机有多种规格。

segments.text: You can choose the size of your centrifuge based on the speed required, tube size, or
segments.zh: 你可以根据所需转速、离心管规格或

segments.text: volume of the sample, and space available in your lab.
segments.zh: 样品体积以及实验室的可用空间来选择离心机的规格。

segments.text: A few things to remember when loading your centrifuge.
segments.zh: 装载离心机时要记住几件事。

segments.text: Always wear the appropriate PPE. The minimum required PPE are lab coat, long pants,
segments.zh: 始终穿戴适当的个人防护装备。最低要求的个人防护装备是实验服、长裤、

segments.text: fully enclosed shoes, safety glasses, and gloves.
segments.zh: 全包裹的鞋、安全眼镜和手套。

segments.text: Balance the load by weighing each tube to ensure that they are evenly matched and
segments.zh: 通过称量每支离心管来配平负载，确保它们重量相当，

segments.text: distribute them directly across from each other.
segments.zh: 并把它们对称地放置在正对面。

segments.text: If you only have one sample, prepare a dummy tube to properly balance the load.
segments.zh: 如果你只有一个样品，要准备一支配平管来正确配平负载。

segments.text: Confirm that the buckets and tubes are properly fitted, dry, and clean.
segments.zh: 确认吊篮和离心管安装到位、干燥且干净。

segments.text: Then, properly secure the lid.
segments.zh: 然后，把盖子正确盖紧。

segments.text: Ensure the centrifuge is on a sturdy, level workspace before starting the
segments.zh: 在启动离心机之前，确保离心机放在稳固、水平的

segments.text: centrifuge.
segments.zh: 工作台面上。

segments.text: If the centrifuge is wobbling or shaking, stop it immediately or pull the plug.
segments.zh: 如果离心机摇晃或抖动，立即停机或拔掉电源插头。

segments.text: It is important to note that this will only stop power to the rotor, which will
segments.zh: 需要注意的是，这只会切断转子的电源，转子

segments.text: still spin until it is slowed to a stop by friction.
segments.zh: 仍会继续旋转，直到被摩擦力减速停下。

segments.text: Wait until the rotor has completely stopped before opening the lid.
segments.zh: 等转子完全停止后再打开盖子。

segments.text: A wobbling centrifuge usually occurs when the rotor is not balanced, and it may
segments.zh: 离心机摇晃通常发生在转子不平衡时，它可能

segments.text: cause significant damage and injure the operator and other laboratory personnel.
segments.zh: 造成严重损坏，并伤及操作人员和其他实验室人员。

segments.text: This concludes the segment on how to safely handle a centrifuge.
segments.zh: 关于如何安全使用离心机的这部分内容到此结束。

segments.zh: 有关离心机的更多信息，请查看下方链接的

segments.zh: 离心机说明页。
